judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the TDD 'red' phase, adding only a Definition of Done (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and two acceptance test files (`registry.acceptance.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`). It did not implement any validation logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or add `ajv` to `package.json`, meaning all the newly added tests fail immediately. Furthermore, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made. Even the tests added by the candidate were placed in non-standard `.acceptance.test.ts` files instead of the requested `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and omitted half of the acceptance criteria test cases.
